description: System maintenance policy and procedures are not established, documented, or disseminated.
applicability: This signal applies to: Cloud Service Providers seeking FedRAMP authorization Federal agencies using cloud services Third-party assessment organizations (3PAOs) Systems processing federal information

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for missing maintenance policy documentation, absence of maintenance procedures, lack of defined maintenance schedules, and no documented maintenance roles and responsibilities.

sources.title: FISMA - Federal Information Security Modernization Act
